scope: Readiness of ONE U1.2/U1.4 spatial input correction for actual owner decision only. This is not routing stage acceptance, release, order or energized-test authorization.
recommendation_basis: The correction has a concrete saved geometry and finite numerical scope. Direct input diffs show only the exact pair escape changes numerically, from 1.0 to 1.5 mm; local 1.9 mm floor, generic 4 mm, 0.6 mm DRAIN hard width, other 21 exceptions, layer/object scope, board size and interfaces remain protected. It avoids wider two-pair or 2 mm concessions and an unauthorized 0.3 mm neck. There is no new overengineering blocker to presenting this limited decision.

complexity_assessment.objects: Exact U1 pins 2/4 F.Cu pad/track escape
complexity_assessment.assessment: A single 0.5 mm envelope extension is narrower in scope than the earlier two-pair proposal. The 2 mm experiment provides no additional benefit for this concrete path. This is bounded minimality of changed constraints, not proof that 1.5 mm is the mathematical minimum possible margin.
complexity_assessment.preserved_conditions: No added-via/zone exemption; all other 21 exceptions unchanged; 1.9 mm floor and generic 4 mm retained.
complexity_assessment.verification_needed: Actual decision and controlled consumer adoption, followed by checks and affected reviews on the saved integrated result.

complexity_assessment.objects: SOURCE B.Cu bridge (113.75,40.5)-(120.5,40.5), width 0.6 mm; two 0.8/0.3 mm vias
complexity_assessment.assessment: The 6.75 mm bridge joins two front SOURCE copper regions divided by the quiet sense branch. It predates the proposed DRAIN addition and is retained in the checkpoint. It is a limited conductor rather than a backside switched-node plane. Removing it merely to reduce via count could disconnect intended SOURCE copper or disturb sense topology; no evidence supports such removal in this decision scope.
complexity_assessment.preserved_conditions: No broad B.Cu SOURCE plane or quiet-region expansion; no via concession. SOURCE zones are reclipped at full 4 mm plus 0.10 mm around new DRAIN copper.
complexity_assessment.verification_needed: Final current/return topology, coupling and physical thermal qualification remain due; present geometry does not establish achieved EMC or temperature.

complexity_assessment.objects: U3 front/back DC_RETURN plates, nine solid thermal vias and dedicated B.Cu branch to C5 negative
complexity_assessment.assessment: Geometry has a thermal and return-topology rationale, not a duplicate circuit or new interface. The dedicated branch avoids making the U3 plate the power-current corridor. Approximately 393.5/400 mm2 and nine vias are conditional geometry, not demonstrated thetaJA85 K/W. Reducing vias or copper on area arithmetic alone is not justified.
complexity_assessment.preserved_conditions: Quiet return separate from D1/LED/C5 charging through-current; no foreign backside signal within the reserved plate; solid thermal joining.
complexity_assessment.verification_needed: As later routing adds shared-net copper, review the actual branch topology and manual-solderability/access, then physical thermal/current/fault qualification before relevant test or release gates.

complexity_assessment.objects: Four saved native copper zones, including separate SOURCE components
complexity_assessment.assessment: Separate native zones preserve disconnected outer components and holes without unsafe polygon aliasing. This implementation complexity protects actual saved geometry and should not be collapsed for cosmetic simplicity. No added BOM, rail, layer, variant, firmware or sourcing burden arises from the one-pair correction.
complexity_assessment.verification_needed: Maintain exact refill/outline/fill containment evidence after future zone changes; the general cached-fill checker limit remains explicit.
